name: PR#8196 927a44c04 -- heap_page_collect_visible (): a record the page does not answer for (relocated, overflow, a log version, an undecoded representation) ends the chunk before it, and the next call answers S_DOESNT_FIT so the row path takes the page from there to its end; counts of batch rows vs row-path records per page (group Z, Z-01)
fakes: spage_next_record: the next record whose slot is above *slotid, S_END past the last (slotted_page.c:3749 walk, PEEK). or_mvcc_get_header: decodes a test header from the record bytes -- all-visible (mvcc_flag 0, insid MVCCID_ALL_VISIBLE, as MVCC_IS_HEADER_ALL_VISIBLE reads it) or OR_MVCC_FLAG_VALID_INSID with an insid the fake snapshot maps to SNAPSHOT_SATISFIED / TOO_OLD_FOR_SNAPSHOT / TOO_NEW_FOR_SNAPSHOT, a non-null prev_version_lsa for the log-version case, the repid. pgbuf_get_vpid_ptr: the fake page's VPID, equal to the one asked, so the collector neither unfixes nor fetches (the scan already holds the page, as scan_batch_next_page () leaves it). heap_page_is_bestspace (seam): false. oid_Root_class_oid: an OID no record has. MVCC_SNAPSHOT is never constructed (mvcc.c not linked): only snapshot_fnc is written, the one member the collector reads. Extra TU src/base/mem_block.cpp: heap_file.c builds a static cubmem::block_allocator (HEAP_SCANCACHE_BLOCK_ALLOCATOR) at load, whose constructor lives there.
note: Both collectors are declared weak in test.cpp and the one the revision's TU defines is called: head (927a44c04 and later) ends the chunk before a record the page does not answer for; 462e6739d and earlier list it for an OID fetch (exc, exc_cap, n_exc). Ran 2026-10-27: 2381ce437 9/9 PASS; 462e6739d 9/9 PASS (the head-only cases SUCCEED early there; the before/after case checks S_END, 9 rows, 1 exception). base 89722cf4e has no heap_page_collect_visible (requires).
